title: Astronomers Are Creating Fake Stars on Purpose, And the Reason Is Surprisingly Practical
desc: Astronomers now create artificial stars using lasers to see the universe more clearly. These laser guide stars help telescopes correct atmospheric blur. This technology allows ground-based telescopes to capture images as sharp as those from space. It opens up more of the night sky for study. This innovation is a significant advancement for astronomy.
